title: Jesse Minter calls Zay Flowers day-to-day with hamstring injury

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jesse Minter calls Zay Flowers day-to-day with hamstring injury
sources.description: Ravens wide receiver Zay Flowers was on his way to a monster day against the Colts, but his hamstring kept him from building on his big start to the 2026 season.
